Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.Card
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.model.Card.BuildingCard.BuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
ItaEngRectangable, Rectangable, BuildingEventListener, Serializable, EventListener
Direct Known Subclasses:
BonusFoodEndTurnCard, BonusHuntingCard, BonusPaintingCard, BonusPointsByClassEndGameCard, CharacterSetCompleteFoodCard, CharacterSetCompletePointEndGameCard, DoubleBuilderPointsCard, DoubleShamanPointsCard, OneMoreCardCard, SamePairInventionsCard, ShamanicImmunityCard, ShamanicThreeStarCard, SustainDiscountByClassCard, TwentyFiveBonusPointsEndGame
public abstract class BuildingCard extends Card implements BuildingEventListener, Serializable
Represents an abstract base class for all Building Cards in the game.

Building cards can be acquired by players by paying a specific food cost. Once acquired, they provide endgame points and act as listeners (BuildingEventListener) that react to specific BuildingEvents triggered during the game.

    • canGet

      public boolean canGet(Player player)
      Checks whether the specified player has enough food to acquire this building.

      The evaluation takes into account any building discounts the player might have in their databank (player.data.getNumBuildingDiscount()).

      Specified by:
      canGet in class Card
      Parameters:
      player - the Player attempting to acquire the card
      Returns:
      true if the player's food is greater than or equal to the eventually discounted price, false otherwise

    • onDraw

      public void onDraw(Player player)
      Handles the logic upon drawing the card, charging the player and setting the ownership.

      The method calculates the final discounted price and subtracts it from the player's food. It uses Math.min(int, int) to ensure that a discount larger than the price does not accidentally reward the player with extra food.

      Overrides:
      onDraw in class Card
      Parameters:
      player - the Player acquiring the card

    • addBuildingToManager

      public void addBuildingToManager(Player owner, EventManager manager)
      Subscribes this building to the provided EventManager.

      This allows the building to "listen" and react whenever its corresponding BuildingEvent is triggered during the game.

      Parameters:
      owner - the Player who owns this building
      manager - the central EventManager of the game
